legacy_python_shaped_surfaces.revisit_rule: Only a new Sifr-native API design can revisit this; migration compatibility is insufficient.
No CPython-shaped process adapter survives M0a.
Future queue API must prove Sifr-native value over channels.
Future adapter requires a separate design gate and cannot be the offload spine.
Process workers require the M6 typed IPC design and a future process-worker phase.
Raw thread objects are not the public execution model.
No process-global warning/filter mutation from concurrent contexts.
Generator decorator helpers require a future generator semantics phase; cleanup scopes remain Sifr-native.
No Python global warning filter adapter ships in this phase.

m0_resolved_decisions.evidence: Server shutdown, process pump tasks, blocking offload, and CPU offload can be represented as typed child handles under TaskGroup or JoinSet without non-fail-fast scope semantics.
m0_resolved_decisions.outcome: Use TaskGroup[E] as the canonical mixed owner; no distinct task.Scope/runtime.Scope is introduced in M0.

m0_resolved_decisions.evidence: Existing generated lowering already treats task and blocking handles as affine observation handles.
m0_resolved_decisions.outcome: TaskHandle[T, E] is public; Task and BlockingTask remain internal/generated names only.

m0_resolved_decisions.evidence: Matches the phase's static handled-failure proof while preserving deterministic fail-fast group exit.
m0_resolved_decisions.outcome: An explicitly awaited and statically handled child failure is observed and is not re-reported at group exit; unhandled child failure triggers fail-fast sibling cancellation and TaskGroupError[E].

m0_resolved_decisions.evidence: Both use homogeneous result/error types unless the user supplies an explicit sum/enum type.
m0_resolved_decisions.outcome: race returns RaceResult { winner_index, outcome, loser_cancellations }; select returns SelectResult { branch_tag, outcome, loser_cancellations }.

m0_resolved_decisions.evidence: Static branch identity is enforced without exposing runtime callback transports or event-loop objects.
m0_resolved_decisions.outcome: select uses a compiler-known named-branch form task.select(name=awaitable, ...); keyword names are static branch tags.

m0_resolved_decisions.evidence: TaskHandle[Status, SubprocessError] would lose first-class pipe ownership; returning Child alone would blur supervision and observation.
m0_resolved_decisions.outcome: TaskGroup.spawn_process returns a distinct ProcessHandle that owns Child status observation plus stdin/stdout/stderr pipe access.

m0_resolved_decisions.evidence: Runtime worker failures and user E remain typed under one homogeneous group error type.
m0_resolved_decisions.outcome: TaskGroup.spawn_blocking/spawn_cpu require TaskGroup[WorkerError[E]] and align with JoinSet.join_all().await -> list[Result[T, WorkerError[E]]].

m0_resolved_decisions.evidence: Prevents hidden shared mutable state while allowing normal async semaphore critical sections.
m0_resolved_decisions.outcome: Sync lock guards cannot cross await. Async lock guards are await-forbidden in M2 unless a specific guard is marked await-safe. Semaphore permits are guard-like: they cannot cross await and cannot escape through returns.

m0_resolved_decisions.evidence: Channels, locks, semaphores, and events cover near-term web/worker/data needs without toy public primitives.
m0_resolved_decisions.outcome: Barrier is deferred-to-phase-X unless M2 finds a near-term production need; Once remains internal-only over std::sync::OnceLock.

production_surfaces.notes: Public affine observation handle; generated/internal Task names remain internal-only.
Canonical mixed structured-runtime owner; no distinct Scope is introduced in M0.
Stable task helpers with typed timeout/cancellation evidence and no public Tokio types.
Native bounded backpressure and synchronization replace queue parity.
Structured blocking and CPU offload; JoinSet is homogeneous and must be consumed.
Private Rayon pools, fixed default sizing from available_parallelism(), no global pool mutation.
M0 chooses distinct ProcessHandle for scoped process supervision while preserving pipe access.
Structured streams for supported signals; arbitrary signal.signal handlers are unsupported.
Deterministic cleanup scopes independent of generator decorator compatibility.
Value-model foundation is importable; explicit propagation remains M5 work with no contextvars parity or implicit dynamic mutation.
Typed, versioned IPC over accepted process pipes; no pickle-style arbitrary object transport.
